title: SWF compile: ProductInfo (tag 41) not emitted — authoring tool metadata missing from published SWFs
description: Tag 41 (ProductInfo) is never emitted by compile.ts and is not defined in tags.ts. Flash Professional always emits this tag to identify the authoring tool version. The tag body contains: product ID (UI32), edition (UI32), major/minor version (UI8), build (UI32), and compile date (UI64). For a Flash 8 clone, use product=8, edition=0, version=8.0.0.0. This is metadata only — no runtime behavior depends on it — but real FLA round-trip fidelity requires it.
